Dr. Amanda Lee, 36, amanda.lee@healthcare.org, 8097654321, linkedin.com/in/leeamanda, New York City
Registered Nurse with 8 years experience in emergency and critical care. Current: Charge Nurse at City General Hospital (2019-present). Previous: ER Nurse at Community Medical (2016-2019). Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support, Pediatric Advanced Life Support, Trauma Nursing Core Course. Skills: Patient Care, Emergency Response, Team Leadership, Electronic Health Records. Led quality improvement initiative that reduced medication errors by 40%. Trainer for new nursing staff. Fluent in Hindi and English.
